bug_semantics: GHSA-j822-46r5-h4qx/CVE-2026-36341 claim a stored XSS: unsanitized Activity comment on POST /admin/activities/create in krayin/laravel-crm 2.1.5, patched in 2.1.6. In the 2.1.5 tree the store path writes request()->all() including comment, but the lead/person/product activity timeline renders that field with v-safe-html (DOMPurify sanitize then innerHTML), the desktop activities datagrid interpolates record.comment as text, and v2.1.6 does not change any of those blobs. The cited patch only strip_tags page titles and sanitizes mail route params.
flaw_origin: Advisory mismatch, not a first-write of unsanitized comment HTML. v2.1.4 and v2.1.5 share the same components/activities/index.blade.php and activities/index.blade.php blobs (v-safe-html on activity.comment). v2.1.5 and v2.1.6 share those blobs and ActivityController.php. Merge fc467040de21803cb2b67c2229d2dfcf731d2d3e (PR 2401) only strip_tags titles (lead/person/product/warehouse/email/webform) and does not touch comment storage or render. Researcher PoC is labeled HTML injection, which is the intended v-safe-html behavior.
evidence: CVE-2026-36341 is PUBLISHED (cveawg.mitre.org state PUBLISHED; assigner mitre; no rejectedReasons; GHSA withdrawn_at null). Advisory text: comment field XSS on /admin/activities/create, composer krayin/laravel-crm =2.1.5 / patched 2.1.6, refs PR 2401 and fc467040de21803cb2b67c2229d2dfcf731d2d3e. git rev-parse v2.1.5=d110d2a39b38d3b66a4b786fb18becc36623bdd2 v2.1.6=68140c0b9f73ab2735ac0e48e7b448de19eaa882. git rev-parse of packages/Webkul/Admin/src/Resources/views/components/activities/index.blade.php, activities/index.blade.php, and Activity/ActivityController.php is identical across v2.1.4, v2.1.5, and v2.1.6 (controller also identical 2.1.5/2.1.6). git show v2.1.5:packages/Webkul/Admin/src/Resources/views/components/activities/index.blade.php has v-if=activity.comment v-safe-html=activity.comment. git show v2.1.5:packages/Webkul/Admin/src/Resources/assets/js/app.js registers app.directive("safe-html", DOMPurify); git show v2.1.5:.../directives/dompurify.js sets el.innerHTML = DOMPurify.sanitize(binding.value). Desktop list uses @{{ record.comment... }} text interpolation. git diff --name-status v2.1.5 v2.1.6 and git show --stat fc467040 show strip_tags on leads/view, contacts/persons/view, products/view, warehouses/view, mail/view, configuration/edit, web-forms/preview titles plus SanitizeUrl from PR 2382; no activity comment path. CHANGELOG v2.1.6 credits #2382 XSS, not a comment sanitizer. Later df1f2fad55690d0860b2e9f7dc730085f075cb3a (v2.2.4+) switches timeline comment to @{{ activity.comment }} and is not an ancestor of v2.1.6. Historical v-html="activity.comment" first appears in 1a592e064e4e845793a2ff4ceb25f34ae4a0abbb (parent a3340c07948410449fb2ca39b52e88360ce2e749 still has escaped @{{ activity.comment }}); fabc2c41978bad04d16b0a9098dd6288e68e3a06 later re-adds v-html on the Vue rewrite; 4848b68af8ce1b973fc60018860c8a8347d2b7bd replaces it with v-safe-html before 2.1.5. git cat-file -p on those commits shows human Webkul authors and no AI trailers; they are not used as a BIC because the published 2.1.5 claim is not an unsanitized comment XSS closed by 2.1.6. CVE.org CVE-2026-36341 is PUBLISHED (fetched 2026-08-29), so this FALSE_POSITIVE is a content-disposition: the advisory's claimed vulnerable sink is contradicted by the code — v2.1.5 d110d2a39b38d3b66a4b786fb18becc36623bdd2 already routes comments through DOMPurify (v-safe-html) and the datagrid escapes them; the v2.1.6 tree leaves those files byte-identical. The advisory is therefore not a security issue in the shipped code path.
reasoning: Vulnerability-first: the published report asserts that 2.1.5 fails to sanitize activity comments and that 2.1.6/PR 2401 closes that. The 2.1.5 timeline already runs comments through DOMPurify via v-safe-html; the desktop datagrid escapes comments; and the 2.1.6 tree leaves those files byte-identical. The named fix only escapes unrelated titles/route params. Researcher materials describe HTML injection, which DOMPurify is designed to allow as markup while stripping scripts. A published CVE that misidentifies both sink and patch is FALSE_POSITIVE, not NOT_AI. Mobile activities cards still v-html record[column.index] including comment (111447b), but that path is unchanged in 2.1.6 and is not the advisory mechanism or the cited fix, so it is not this case BIC.
remaining_gap: None None: the FALSE_POSITIVE disposition rests on the sink-contradiction evidence above (advisory wrong about the vulnerable code path), not on a withdrawn/rejected CVE record.
